plain: The public announcement of a law or decree

webster.text: The act of promulgating; publication; open declaration; as the promulgation of the law or of the gospel.

example.quote: Such transactions as relate to military operations or atfairs of groat consequence, the immediate promulgation of which might defeat the interests of the community, I would not wish to be published, till the end which required their secrecy should have been effected.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
